purpose: Execute an actual independent open-source backtesting engine on newly acquired DEX candle data, rather than add wallet scaffolding or rerun the old Ethereum-2021 sample.

engine.name: backtesting.py
engine.license: AGPL-3.0; keep experiment source and third-party notice separate from existing MIT runtime
engine.execution: FractionalBacktest, long-only, no leverage, next-bar market fills; no live executor

data.provider: Trading Strategy documented public JSONL API
data.probe_disclosure: One day of ETH data (2026-09-01) was inspected only for schema/access before this protocol; no strategy result inspected. Prior Arz research saw overlapping ETH price history, so this is not a pristine project-wide holdout.
data.validation: Correct pair IDs, chronological unique UTC bars, finite consistent OHLC, nonnegative reported volume, explicit missing-bar coverage and no invented historical fills. Gaps invalidate contiguous evaluation windows rather than being silently interpolated. Retain licensed data privately while redistribution permission is unresolved.

fixed_hypotheses.adaptation: Long entry on SMA10 crossing above SMA20; close rather than short on reverse crossover. Shared risk overlay; not the original full-capital long-short example.
Wilder RSI14 below30 entry, above70 exit; only signal-level adaptation, NOT execution of Freqtrade engine or its ROI/stop settings.
Completed close above prior20-bar highs enters; below prior10-bar lows exits; original bounded implementation, no claimed external strategy track record.

shared_policy.stop_scope: Observed completed-bar signals close at next open; gaps can exceed limits. No fabricated on-chain native stop.
shared_policy.compounding: Recompute desired order from current marked account equity; profits retained, losses reduce size; hard $25 order cap limits scaling above $125. No external top-ups.

cost_scenarios.status: Optimistic lower-bound diagnostic only; zero network cost is NOT claimed observed.
Uncalibrated sensitivity: pool fee plus adverse-execution budget; not certified current/historical DEX costs.
Higher-cost sensitivity; does not prove all possible costs or worst-case risk.

selection: No hyperparameter search or optimization. Report all fixed strategies, failed windows and costs. No winner chosen by recent-window return alone. Overlapping horizons and correlated assets are not independent statistical trials. A positive candle-screening result can justify future diagnostic paper observation, not financial approval.
benchmarks: Cash and 20%-initial-equity buy-and-hold, same cost scenario; separate marked and terminal liquidation values. Never use full-capital buy-and-hold as the only risk comparator.
tests_before_market_runs: Flat-market round trip loses exactly modeled costs
Cash cannot be created by fractional scaling
Closed-trade PnL and final account reconcile
Profit resizes subsequent order, subject to cap
Future data perturbation cannot change earlier signals
No end-of-window liquidation at a previously known price
Windows/gaps and source IDs fail closed
required_outputs: Pinned dependencies/upstream refs, data provenance and coverage, actual engine run logs, all results CSV, representative full ledgers, calendar-day geometric returns, drawdown, fees, frequency, benchmark comparison, equivalent FA/EN report and retained negative outcomes.
limitations: New-source candle sensitivity benchmark, not exact historical AMM replay. Issuer/provider/route eligibility and own-order all-in fees remain separate unresolved live gates. A 24/7 data/strategy design is not 24/7 profitable trading. No guarantee that iteration finds an edge.
